tests.name: Password-Protected ZIP Payload Extraction and Execution
tests.description:
Extracts and executes a script from a password-protected ZIP archive.
This technique is commonly used by malware families like Emotet and QBot to deliver payloads
via email attachments where the password is provided in the message body.
The encrypted ZIP evades static file analysis until extracted at runtime.
Upon successful execution, displays confirmation and system information.

tests.name: Turla Snake Queue File Artifact
tests.description:
Creates a fake Snake malware queue file in %windir%\Registration with the naming convention
<RANDOM_GUID>.<RANDOM_GUID>.crmlog, filled with random bytes to simulate encrypted data that will be decrypted by Snake's kernel driver.
In real samples, the decrypted queue file contans key material, communication channels, modes of operation, logs, and command specifications.

Reference: https://media.defense.gov/2023/May/09/2003218554/-1/-1/0/JOINT_CSA_HUNTING_RU_INTEL_SNAKE_MALWARE_20230509.PDF
